goal: channel presentation videos that push viewers to subscribe

defaults.voiceover: record yourself or generate with Higgsfield generate_audio; mix over a DJBILBOX beat
defaults.text_overlay_rule: never generate text with AI; add logo, subscribe button and captions in CapCut
defaults.negative: text, watermark, logo, distorted hands, blurry, low quality

videos.title: Welcome to the HUMPIRE
videos.voiceover: Welcome to the HUMPIRE. Free VSTs, plugins, drum kits and beats, built by a producer for producers. G-Funk, trap, afrotrap, oriental. Subscribe, and build your empire.
shots: 0-3s: low-angle gold-lit throne of drum machines and speakers, smoke, first kick shakes the frame
3-9s: fast cuts of glowing plugin interfaces, MPC pads, waveforms exploding into gold particles
9-15s: camera pushes to the producer silhouette who points at the lens
videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 epic cinematic brand intro. Low-angle shot of a throne built from drum machines and speakers in gold smoke, a heavy kick shakes the frame. Fast cuts of glowing plugin interfaces, MPC pads and waveforms exploding into gold particles. Final push-in on a producer silhouette pointing at the camera. West Coast sunset gold and purple lighting.

videos.title: Why subscribe? 3 reasons
videos.voiceover: Three reasons to subscribe. One: free VSTs every month. Two: new beats and drum kits, ready for your DAW. Three: tutorials to make hits faster. Hit subscribe, and join the HUMPIRE.
shots: 0-5s: gift box slams onto desk, holographic synth opens
5-10s: stack of glowing drum kit boxes and a beat waveform rolls across a wall of speakers
10-15s: DAW cascade of plugin windows opening to the beat, cursor clicks a red subscribe-style button
videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 punchy explainer. A glowing gift box slams onto a studio desk and a holographic synth opens above it. Then a stack of black drum kit boxes with glowing edges, then plugin windows cascading open on a monitor to the beat. Bright accent lighting, quick snappy cuts, friendly high energy.
videos.cta_overlay: FREE VSTs | NEW BEATS | TUTORIALS | SUBSCRIBE

videos.title: Meet the Producer
videos.voiceover: I'm DJBILBOX. Beatmaker, plugin developer, builder of the HUMPIRE. I make the sounds you hear, and the tools you use. Subscribe and watch it grow.
shots: 0-5s: night studio, hands on MIDI keyboard, neon through the window
5-10s: C++ code on a screen morphing into a plugin knob turning
10-15s: slow push-in on the producer's face, smirk, glow of the screen
videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic documentary. Night studio, hands on a MIDI keyboard, neon city through the window. Lines of C++ code on a monitor morph into a glowing plugin knob that turns. Slow push-in on the producer's face lit by screen glow, subtle smirk. Moody teal and orange, shallow depth of field.

videos.title: Free Download Hook
videos.voiceover: Want free plugins? Stop scrolling. Subscribe, and grab the free HUMPIRE VSTs, link in bio.
shots: 0-2s: hand stops a scrolling phone feed mid-swipe, freeze, shockwave
2-7s: phone screen turns into a 3D plugin interface floating off the screen
7-10s: plugin bursts into particles, subscribe-bell glow
videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 scroll-stopper. A hand freezes a phone feed mid-swipe, shockwave ripple. The phone screen peels into a 3D glowing plugin interface floating in the air, then bursts into golden particles with a glowing notification bell. Dark background, vivid orange and cyan accents, fast snappy motion.
videos.cta_overlay: FREE VSTs | LINK IN BIO | SUBSCRIBE

shots: 0-3s: crypt door slams open, orange light, skeleton producer hits a pad
3-9s: skeletons headbang, bats burst from a synth, pumpkin skull with headphones
9-12s: skull points at the camera, bell glow
videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic horror-comedy. A crypt door slams open in orange light, a skeleton producer hits a glowing pad, skeletons with headphones headbang to a G-Funk trap beat, bats burst out of a giant synth, a jack-o'-lantern skull with gold chains points at the camera. Orange and purple volumetric lighting, fast energetic camera.

videos.title: Subscribe Outro (loop)
videos.voiceover: Enjoyed this? Subscribe to HUMPIRE by DJBILBOX BEATS. New drops every week.

videos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 seamless loop. A gold crown floats above a glowing speaker stack, waveform rings pulse outward, golden particles drift. Dark studio background, warm gold rim light, slow gentle camera drift, perfect loop.
